page_title: LEC 2-1 TOR | Lecce v Torino 30/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' The resulting corner from Kristjan Asllani (Torino) is cleared by the defence.
90+3' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
90+2' Substitution. Nikola Stulic makes way for Corrie Ndaba (Lecce).

90+1' Kristjan Asllani (Torino) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot into the bottom right corner. Wladimiro Falcone anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort.
90+1' Kristjan Asllani (Torino) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' The Torino players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

87' Play continues despite the shouts by some Torino players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Maurizio Mariani interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
87' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Torino for a penalty. Play continues.
86' A quickly taken corner by Torino.
83' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Saul Coco (Torino) is given a yellow card.
83' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Medon Berisha is replaced by Mohamed Kaba (Lecce).
81' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) picks up a yellow card.
80' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.

80' Corner kick. Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) is ready to send the ball into the box. The corner by Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
78' Cesare Casadei (Torino) receives a harsh yellow card from the referee after committing a minor foul on his opponent.
76' Saul Coco (Torino) commits a rough foul. Maurizio Mariani stops the game and makes a call.
76' Adam Masina (Torino) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
75' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
75' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
73' Medon Berisha (Lecce) produces a poor lofted pass into the penalty box. His attempt is easily thwarted by the defence.
71' Substitution. Valentino Lazaro in, Marcus Pedersen (Torino) out.
70' That's the end of the game for Nikola Vlasic, who is replaced by Zakaria Aboukhlal (Torino).
70' Here comes a substitution. Niels Nkounkou (Torino) is given a rest as he is replaced by Adam Masina.
69' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Nikola Vlasic (Torino), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
65' Here is a change. Lameck Banda is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Riccardo Sottil (Lecce).
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tete Morente will replace Santiago Pierotti (Lecce).
62' The number of shots on goal at present is 2:6.
61' Saul Coco (Torino) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
60' Marco Baroni has decided to substitute Adrien Tameze (Torino) and he is replaced by Cyril Ngonge.
57' 2 - 1 Goal! Nikola Vlasic passes the ball to Che Adams (Torino) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Wladimiro Falcone couldn't do anything about it. 2:1.
56' Cesare Casadei (Torino) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
54' Medon Berisha (Lecce) takes a short corner kick.
54' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) plays a long ball to Nikola Stulic, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.
51' Poor challenge! Adrien Tameze (Torino) is penalised for tripping and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle.
49' Lameck Banda (Lecce) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' A corner kick by Torino is thwarted by the well prepared Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce).
45' 2 additional min. will be played.

44' Duvan Zapata (Torino) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though it was aimed precisely towards the middle of the goal, Wladimiro Falcone didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough.
41' Cesare Casadei (Torino) misses a rebound from the penalty spot. The ball flies just a few inches over the bar.
40' The referee awards a corner and Kristjan Asllani (Torino) goes over to take it.
39' A cross from a corner kick by Torino is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

38' OFF THE CROSSBAR! Niels Nkounkou (Torino) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
37' Marco Baroni has decided to make a change. Duvan Zapata (Torino) replaces Gvidas Gineitis.
36' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Torino comes to nothing.

34' Kristjan Asllani (Torino) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick in order to find one of his teammates. His poor effort, however, sails way out of play. The ball goes out of play. Torino are awarded a corner kick.
33' The ball is out of play. Torino will have a chance to score from a corner.
32' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) commits a foul and Maurizio Mariani immediately signals a free kick.
31' Lecce get a corner.
28' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
24' No offside! Referee Maurizio Mariani points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Lecce players.
23' The Lecce players halt their celebrations as referee Maurizio Mariani makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
22' 2 - 0 Lameck Banda (Lecce) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
20' 1 - 0 Medon Berisha takes over corner duties and expertly finds Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the middle of the goal. The score is now 1:0.
20' Medon Berisha (Lecce) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
20' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Lecce will take a corner kick.
17' One of the Torino players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. A free kick to Lecce.
16' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Che Adams (Torino), but the defence gets it clear.
15' A header by Che Adams (Torino) from very close range goes towards the middle of the target, but doesn't get past Wladimiro Falcone, who makes a nice save.
11' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
8' The ball is behind the sideline. Antonino Gallo (Lecce) takes a throw-in.
1' The resulting set piece from Lecce is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Cyril Ngonge (Torino) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
The players are out at last! Lecce will take the kick-off.
Maurizio Mariani will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
